correctness.rationale: For a>-1 the factor A=(1+a+y²)/(1+y²) is everywhere positive. The left-right affine coordinate reduction gives V=phi_U(y)=y+U-Ua/(1+a+y²); its derivative and the exact maximum of |y|/(1+a+y²)² give the sharp threshold. A sign chart proves one/two/three distinct real preimages in all cases. The two points where the first and second fiber derivatives vanish have nonzero cubic derivative and nonzero unfolding derivative. Taylor expansion gives the exact 3/2 fold separation. Properness and Brouwer degree +1 are proved from A positive. The included checker passed 864 rational identity cases, two cusp factorizations, an exact triple-preimage example and 12 finite cusp-asymptotic checks; those are not used as infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Full HTML scientific sections of Zhang et al. 2022 give the exact rational map and fixed-point/Jacobian analysis, followed by numerical bifurcation diagrams; no global inverse-fiber/cusp theorem or onset coefficient appears. Classical noninvertible-map theory covers generic fold/cusp phenomenology but has no implication giving this particular rational map's exact threshold, locations, or global partition. The 2005 polynomial Z1-Z3-Z1 family and the 2025 rational Z0-Z2 family have inequivalent inverse equations. Relevant semantic searches of published mathematical results found similar exact inverse-sector theorems only for other maps. Priority risk remains for unindexed sources.
residual_risks: The 2005 polynomial-family full article was not read in its entirety; the visible model already distinguishes it and its conclusions may contain general tools, but it is not the same rational map.
A complete text of the 2025 paper was not material-read; its visible explicit map and stated Z0-Z2 valence preclude direct domination, but its references may contain related general arguments.
Unindexed papers or unpublished computations might contain the same family-specific inverse formulas.
The 2021/2022 publisher pages disagree on accepted-manuscript online date, although both possible dates lie in the same eligibility cohort.

value.rationale: The map is an explicitly published four-parameter rational family investigated through its attractors. Global inverse valence is structurally consequential for basin connectivity and critical-set geometry. The exact, exhaustive 1/2/3-real-preimage classification, two cusp coordinates, and sharp cusp opening quantify the whole natural critical-value set and inverse branches, rather than selecting an arbitrary numerical slice. This does not claim a new general cusp theorem or a forward attractor classification.
